footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Babcock & Wilcox: after $14.9M of preferred dividends, $3.3M of other items, net.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 1.1% to $588M in 2025. Gross margin was 24.5%, versus 21.8% a year earlier, and operating income was $20.7M, up from a $6.3M loss.
The net loss narrowed to $51.0M, or −$0.48 per share, from $74.8M. Operating cash flow was −$68.9M and free cash flow −$85.7M, versus −$130M; Babcock & Wilcox returned $386K through buybacks.
sources: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
